session_read: Monday pre-open, gate ESCALATING on a single term -- KOSPI -3.12%, an Asia-session move that scout's own read calls a continuation of the TSMC-capex-guide profit-taking that's been running for a month, not a fresh shock. Nothing traded since this morning's quick sweep; the book is exactly where it was at 08:55, just eight hours' worth of pre-market repricing lower (-1.51% weighted) and one live structural finding layered on top. That finding is the one worth leading with: Broadcom's off-balance-sheet AI-financing platform, which drove a bond downgrade two weeks ago, has grown from a $35bn tranche to a $70-80bn SPV negotiation -- and Blackstone is now named as counterparty, not just an analyst inference. BX was re-entered THIS MORNING as a 10-share probe, and by this afternoon the same catalyst that's trimming AVGO applies to it directly; the honest version of today's review is a strategist proposing to partially reverse a position it opened hours earlier, which is exactly what got surfaced rather than smoothed over. Three other names -- BABA, HOOD, MRVL -- each had a real overnight story, and all three resolved the same way: less dramatic under a source check than the price action implied. BABA's drop is a genuine earnings miss but 0.6% of the book. HOOD's rally is Bitcoin, not AI-capex. MRVL's slide is profit-taking after its own Google-deal rally, confirmed independently by three separate agents rather than asserted once. The technical layer went dark this run -- RSI and relative-strength caches are 12 days stale, a deliberate skip given the cost of a 33-name pre-market refresh -- so every overbought/oversold read this cycle is either silent or explicitly caveated, never guessed. And the review caught two of its own bugs live: a dedup routine that let same-day proposal updates lose to older, more verbose ones on a coin flip, and a retirement rule that would have killed the book's single worst cap overage the moment its supporting catalyst went quiet, ignoring that the cap breach alone was reason enough. Both are fixed and pushed, not just noted for later.
